turns.label: Clinician

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hi, I've had um I've had a cough for the past um three days and uh I also developed a fever, um I think, so I checked it yesterday night, it was um 38. And uh I just decided to uh come into the walk in clinic just to um just to get myself checked out.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah certainly, it it sounds like you um have had a fever as well, so uh with the cough, you said that started three days ago, has it been getting uh any better or any worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's gotten a little bit better, I'd say.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, that's good. Um and and prior to three days ago, um did you have a cough before or was it a new new cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's a new cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and uh are you bringing up any sputum?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: Um are you bringing up any blood?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have you had any shortness of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm no, I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, um how about any wheezing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I guess a little bit.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: A bit, OK. Um is it uh, are you having any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, um and so you mentioned um, with a fever have have you had any chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah I did. Um I had the chills yesterday.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you had any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and um have you had any eye redness, runny nose, or even a sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't.

turns.text: Alright, have you had any uh nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.text: Uh a loss of taste or loss of smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any skin changes or uh rashes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And how has your energy been? Have you had fatigue?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um a little bit.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and have you had any muscle aches or or body pains?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, not much. No, but yeah, it's just I've been feeling, yeah, I guess a little bit. I have been feeling achy, uhm but I just thought it was my fibromyalgia acting acting up, but yeah, it's it's been worse over the past three days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uh so you've had um this cough, a dry cough, a fever, chills, and uh been more tired and and been a little bit more achy these past uh three days. Have you had any other symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you tried anything to make it better?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh I just took a day or two off of work and I just rested and um had a lot of uh hot water. It helped me, uh It helped with the cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK great, and um have you had any uh like symptoms like this before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, um, yeah I mean, when I I guess I get sick I do get similar symptoms like when I get the cold or the flu, but I usually have like a runny nose um or like a stuffy nose, but that's kind of different this time, a little bit.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and in the past have you been uh diagnosed with any medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I have fibromyalgia and uh I um also have schizophrenia.

turns.text: OK, and are you taking medications currently?

turns.text: Uh yeah. Uhm, I take um quetiapine and uh I just I take Advil um when my uh joint pains are really bad.

turns.text: OK, and do you have a um somebody that follows you along for either uh fibromyalgia or or schizophrenia?

turns.text: Um my family doc. And then um yeah, it's pretty much just him. Um he, yeah.

turns.text: OK. And uh do you have any allergies to medications?

turns.text: Alright and um are you aware if your immunizations are up to date?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yeah.

turns.text: Alright, and could you tell me, alright then sorry actually, uh have you had any hospitalizations or uh previous surgeries?

turns.text: Uhm well, I uh I've been hospitalized. I I was kept in the psych unit for a couple of days, um two years ago. But nothing other than that.

turns.text: OK. Um and it's been stable since then?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.text: Uh sure, so I'm living with my um I'm living with my husband and uh we live in an apartment.

turns.text: OK, and has he been sick or has anybody you've been around been sick?

turns.text: Uhm, he was sick last week but he got better on his own.

turns.text: OK, and were were his symptoms similar to yours or or uh or were they different?

turns.text: Um they were kind of different, I would say. He just had a um he had a sore throat and uh that kind of lasted for three or four days, and then he just got better.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and um are you currently working or um?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I uh no, I'm a I'm a stay at home, I just stay at home, I don't work.

turns.text: OK, and so and have you traveled anywhere or any other uh potential exposures?

turns.text: OK yeah, how much?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh it's good that you've been able to cut down, so congratulations on that. Um and do you drink alcohol?

turns.text: Uhm I I do. Uh, I'll drink um sometimes with my friends maybe uh once a month or once in two three months. Um but I haven't been going out with them since the pandemic started, so I haven't had much to drink. I haven't had anything to drink um since the past year.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um I see. And uh have you had any um history of heart or lung conditions in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: OK, yeah, and I think that that was all the questions that I wanted to ask on on history today before we go ahead on to the physical exam. Uh did you have anything that you wanted to add maybe before um that I forgot to ask about?

turns.text: Uh no.
